description: MDB: DBEngine.SetOption valid & invalid value-type matrix across dbPageTimeout(6), dbMaxBufferSize(8), dbLockRetry(57), dbUserCommitSync(58), dbImplicitCommitSync(59), dbMaxLocksPerFile(62), dbLockDelay(63), dbRecycleLVs(65), plus unknown option codes (999, 0, -1, 'bad'), called BEFORE OpenDatabase and again AFTER OpenDatabase (read-write). Keeps all pages before open, while open, and after Close to verify 0-byte file invariance.
